release_notes: Mandatory OPS Android 4.5.23 Task photo capture fix. Native camera results now enter the exact Task photo evidence group directly instead of relying on synthetic file-input change events. Android Camera Activity restoration is handled so a captured photo is not silently lost when the app is recreated. The photo appears locally before watermark/upload/D1 registration, with retry/remove kept on the photo tile. No D1 migration or backfill.
